title: The big kite festival.
lines: In January there is a special festival in India.
It's called Makar Sankranti, and in some cities it's called Uttarayan.
Then winter is almost over, and every day the sun shines a little bit longer.
And do you know what people do then?
They fly kites!
Thousands and thousands of kites!
Kavya lives in Antwerp, but this year she is celebrating the festival with her cousins in Ahmedabad, in India.
Kavya, says her cousin Vihaan, tomorrow we're flying kites on the roof!
On the roof?
asks Kavya.
Yes!
In India the roofs are flat, and everyone goes up.
The evening before the festival they make kites together.
They take thin coloured paper and light bamboo sticks.
They glue and they cut.
Kavya makes a pink kite with a big yellow sun on it.
And a long tail of ribbons.
The next morning they climb the stairs to the roof.
Wow!
Kavya looks around.
There are people on all the roofs.
Children, mummies, daddies, grandpas and grandmas.
And hundreds of kites are already flying in the sky.
Red, green, blue, purple, with stripes and with stars.
The sky looks like a big colourful painting.
Vihaan holds the string.
Kavya holds the kite up.
One, two, three, let go!
The wind catches the kite, and whoosh!
Up it goes.
Higher and higher!
Kavya gets to hold the string too.
She can feel the wind pulling on the kite.
Hee hee, it wants to fly away!
Everywhere you hear people shouting.
Kai po che!
They shout that when they've brought down another kite.
Because it's also a game: the kites try to cut each other's strings.
But Kavya just wants her pink kite to fly as high as possible.
There's a big party on the roof.
There's music.
And Auntie brings tasty things.
Chikki, a sweet made of peanuts and sugar, crunchy and sweet.
And there are laddoos made of sesame seeds.
Mmm!
Kavya's kite flies all day long.
It dances among the clouds.
In the evening, when it gets dark, people send up little lanterns.
They float up, like little stars.
It's so beautiful.
Tired but happy, Kavya goes to sleep.
And when she's back in Antwerp, she takes her pink kite with her.
On a windy day she goes to the park with Daddy.
And she flies her kite high above the river Scheldt.
